changelog: Campaign profiles: keep multiple save slots, each with its own unlocks, progress and run — switch anytime from Settings. Fog of war now randomizes properly with matching edges and remembers explored ground under a veil. New framed boss portraits, shown big on the reveal. Battles open focused on your camp, and anything that hits you from the fog (a lurking gator, a long-range shot) is now revealed with a tracer so you can hit back. Storms reworked into an eye-and-ring that drifts over any terrain. Clearer events (the scrapped card is shown), tap any map node to see what it is, and an End-Turn confirm when units can still act. Plus outpost/cache/draft cleanup and ornate framed toasts.
